Topics covered in this PDF

BHIE-143 (History of Environment) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Ecofeminism in the Indian context, NGOs and environmental movements in India, man-environment relations in medieval India, Green Imperialism, environment in Indian philosophy
  • Environmental history, water resources in ancient river-valley civilizations, animal hunting under the East India Company, biodiversity and protection, the Tinai concept of the Sangam age

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: Tutor Marked Assignment, total marks 100. Section 1: two questions in about 500 words (20 each). Section 2: three questions in about 250 words (10 each). Section 3: five short notes in about 100 words (6 each)

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.

How to use the solved PDF properly

This PDF is study and reference material. Use it like this:

  • First read your official assignment paper and choose the questions you must answer
  • Learn the answer structure from the PDF: introduction, concept or facts, examples and conclusion
  • Write your final answer in your own words. The university alone evaluates it
